role: Declares the MorningReanalysisControls value type (not a View) holding the view model, session, collector, reanalysis/manual-window closures and the bindings the reanalysis and export controls mutate; behaviour lives in the extension in MorningResultsView+Reanalysis.swift.
types: MorningReanalysisControls: struct (@MainActor) — input bundle for reanalysis/manual-window/strap-merge/export controls; constructed by MorningResultsView+ReanalysisForwarding.swift and UncoveredScreenSnapshotTests.swift
toplevel: Only stored lets (vm, session, result, recentSessions, collector, sessionReanalysis — the saved-session reanalysis a strap merge rescores through — onReanalyze, onReanalyzeAt, onApplyManualResult) and @Binding vars (exportURL, emailURL, isManualWindowMode, manualResult, manualPickMessage, strapMergeWorking, strapMergeMessage, pendingWindowMethod — the Analysis Window pick awaiting confirmation — and reanalysisDeclined — set when a re-analysis returned no session); memberwise init synthesized. No behaviour in this file.
